question: Does a zinc-fortified textured-soy or soy-and-pork school dish raise serum zinc and haemoglobin in children aged 6 to 10 over 4 to 5 months, and do children eat it?
why_it_matters: Decides whether a fortified plant dish can be named in menu software and whether TPP-11 is a lead brief for UNICEF and provinces
cheapest_way_to_close: Cluster trial in 6 to 10 schools served by one caterer, on the design of NIN 2009 (NQR-22), with plate waste recorded
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute of Nutrition; UNICEF Viet Nam; one multi-school caterer

question: What are the phytate-to-zinc molar ratios, zinc and iron contents and DIAAS (both patterns) of Vietnamese tofu, textured soy and a 25% soy minced-pork dish?
why_it_matters: Sets the fortification level and tests whether tofu days count as moderate or poor zinc absorption
cheapest_way_to_close: Laboratory analysis of 10 samples for phytate and minerals; DIAAS through an overseas pig or in vitro laboratory
owner_org_to_ask: National Institute of Nutrition; NIFC; an overseas DIAAS laboratory

question: What complementary-food standard will UNICEF and MOH adopt under the 2027 to 2031 programme, and does it require animal-source protein or a DIAAS threshold?
why_it_matters: Decides whether any soy-based product can enter stunting programmes
cheapest_way_to_close: Call to UNICEF Viet Nam nutrition section and the MOH Department of Disease Prevention; read any draft standard
owner_org_to_ask: UNICEF Viet Nam; Ministry of Health

question: What does Decision 116/QD-VDD (2026 RNI) set for zinc and iron by bioavailability and for upper limits at ages 6 to 11, and for protein in girls aged 8 and over?
why_it_matters: Fixes the lunch targets and caps fortification levels
cheapest_way_to_close: Request the full text from NIN or find it on the NIN document pages

question: What do border-commune school kitchens under Decree 339/2025 serve, how much animal food, and what do they pay for protein foods?
why_it_matters: If upland lunches are mostly rice and vegetables, the zinc gap is large and TPP-11 has a funded buyer
cheapest_way_to_close: Read published menus on school sites in Dien Bien, Son La, Lao Cai, Tuyen Quang and Cao Bang; call three schools
owner_org_to_ask: Provincial departments of education; school principals

question: Will the amendment to Decree 09/2016 add new mandatory vehicles (rice, seasoning, fish sauce) or school-meal rules, and when?
why_it_matters: A new vehicle such as fortified rice would supply zinc to every school lunch and weaken the case for fortifying a protein dish
cheapest_way_to_close: Track the MOH draft and Government decisions on thuvienphapluat and chinhphu.vn
owner_org_to_ask: Ministry of Health (Department of Food Safety; NIN)

question: What does food-grade zinc oxide or zinc sulphate premix cost delivered in Vietnam per mg of zinc?
why_it_matters: The only cost in the fortified-dish comparison we could not price
